hooks.name: Necro scan on save
hooks.description: After saving a src ts/tsx file, scan it with necro-docs scan_code and report only new patchable findings.

action.prompt: A src TypeScript file was just saved. Read the saved file and call the necro-docs scan_code tool with its repo-relative path and current content. Compare with the previous scan_code result for this file in this session, if any. Report in ONE short message only the findings that are new and have patchable: true. If there are none, say nothing. Do not edit files and do not call synthesize_patch unless the user asks.
